callouts.label: Understand OER and licenses
callouts.hint: A book with an open lock on its cover, at the start of the loop.
callouts.description: Learn what makes a resource open and how the six Creative Commons licenses work. Chapters 1 and 2.
callouts.tip: Open means permission, not price. Everything later in the loop depends on reading a license correctly.

callouts.label: Publish and train others
callouts.hint: A ribbon badge with a star, just before the loop closes.
callouts.description: Package improved components with a license and metadata, publish them openly, and train other teachers. Chapters 18 and 19.
callouts.tip: Published work and trained reviewers bring new resources back to station 1.

callouts.label: Calibrate the agent against the test results
callouts.hint: A dial with a needle, at the start of the thick return arrow.
callouts.description: Compare the agent's scores with what the students actually learned, then adjust the prompt. Chapters 14 and 17.
callouts.tip: This is the thick return arrow to station 3. It is how automated scores earn trust.

callouts.label: Test the change with students in an A/B test
callouts.hint: Two groups of people separated by a vertical divider.
callouts.description: Randomly assign students to the original or the improved version, and compare learning gain. Chapters 16 and 17.
callouts.tip: Change one thing at a time, and say that a small test is evidence, not proof.

callouts.label: Score a resource by hand with the ten-metric rubric
callouts.hint: A worksheet with a column of check boxes.
callouts.description: Score ten metrics, five for quality and five for reusability, and add them up to a total out of 100. Chapters 3 to 11.
callouts.tip: Scoring by hand first gives you the human judgment that the agent will later be compared with.

callouts.label: Direct an AI agent to make a first pass
callouts.hint: A window with a prompt arrow, where the return arrow ends.
callouts.description: Write a rubric prompt, run the agent, and collect its scores with evidence. Chapters 12 and 13.
callouts.tip: The return arrow from station 7 ends here: each pass should be better calibrated than the last.

callouts.label: Check the agent's evidence
callouts.hint: A magnifying glass over a page.
callouts.description: Open each quoted source and recompute each score. Look for factual, license, citation, and scoring errors. Chapter 14.
callouts.tip: A fluent report is not a correct report. Agreement with a human can also come from chance.

callouts.label: Improve the lowest metrics with agents
callouts.hint: A wrench beside an upward arrow, the only marker in its color.
callouts.description: Fix the lowest-scoring metric first, using agents for alt text, readability, metadata, and more, with a human check on every change. Chapter 15.
callouts.tip: An agent's edited copy is a derivative work, so read the license before the first edit.
